title: Redirect a client
summary: Ruby on Rails: Redirect a client. Inspect the first 302 response.
introduction: redirect_to sends a Location header. A browser following GET /start reaches /hello.
learningObjectives: Redirect a client with Ruby on Rails

blocks.text: Create a practice project with rails new school --api --skip-active-record. Enter it. Put each labelled section into its named file, then run bin/rails server -b 127.0.0.1 -p 8000. No database is needed.

blocks.title: Redirect a client
blocks.code:
# config/routes.rb
Rails.application.routes.draw do
get "/start", to: "lesson#start"
get "/hello", to: "lesson#hello"
end

# app/controllers/lesson_controller.rb
class LessonController < ActionController::API
def start
 redirect_to "/hello"
end
def hello
 render plain: "Welcome"
end
end

blocks.text: redirect_to sends /hello as the next URL. The client then receives Welcome.
